status: Qualified prepared native CUDA attention session controller: attention, grouped projection and SWA update with completion-gated ring commit. QKV/compressor production, Engram, full native forward/generation admission and vLLM parity remain open.

implementation.ownership: Additional request-local buffers in the existing native FFN/KV/SWA/index session; weights remain immutable backend-owned native core/parameter handles. Architecture anatomy owns groups/ranks/sharing.
implementation.quota: Additional group-major attention output, direct concatenated projection intermediate, F32 delta, and maxima of split attention partials over all legal short chunk lengths. Setup validates quotas before allocation, is transactional/idempotent, and forbids live upgrades.
implementation.sequence: Require active index begin epoch, fresh owner pool and current selection revision; consume PRE-update ring/current prepared Q/KV, native attention, grouped projection, ring update on one request stream. One completion fence precedes ring cursor/begin commit; whole-model position is unchanged.
implementation.failure: Metadata rejection leaves output/state unchanged. Backend rejection or completion failure destroys request; reset/setup required. One success per layer and begin epoch.
implementation.index_revision: Index results carry owner pool_generation (including dense/no-new-row publications) and selection_revision for each producing gathered selection within a begin epoch. Shared readers retain them. Attention rejects stale results after same-extent republication, source overwrite or a new begin.

references.method: Original unchanged dsa_attn wrapper/kernels/SMEM picker plus grouped projection and LinearFP16.forward ASTs. F32 hgemm.cu original argument/workspace policy replay; not compiled full PyTorch extension.
references.geometry: H64/D512/G8, synthetic hidden dimension128/output rank128. Synthetic FP8 WoA/WoB constant0.125, scales127, zero learned sinks, finite prepared queries/KV and pooled latents.
references.sequences: Six chunks: (pos,rows)=(0,273),(273,273),(546,1),(547,7),(554,33),(546,33). Sliding layer0 and dense pooled layer2, two requests, two reset/recreate repetitions.
references.scope: Real controller integration with independently computed nonzero outputs and ring contents. Prepared Q/KV/latents; not QKV/compressor producer qualification or full-prefix model forward. Actual checkpoint attention/projection primitives qualified in preceding component artifacts.
